UI_profdesc_KRjobs_hitman: A quiet professional of the early 90s underworld. Close and silent work.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_architect: Designed houses and offices around Louisville. Knows how a building stands up.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_ironworker: Welded gates, railings and fire escapes. Half welder, half smith.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_survivalist: Wilderness survival instructor. Spent more nights in the woods than at home.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_hotrodder: Rebuilt muscle cars in a garage full of chrome and grease.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_mailcarrier: Walked a long rural route every day, dogs included.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_boxer: Golden Gloves regular. Hits hard and keeps moving.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_diver: Pulled sailors and pilots out of cold water for the US Navy.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_navyseal: Special warfare operator, back home on leave when it all started.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_fighterpilot: Flew F-16s out of an Air National Guard base. Knows systems and survival.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_rangeinstructor: Ran a shooting range and taught concealed carry classes.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_surgeon: Trauma surgeon at a Louisville hospital. Precise hands, long shifts.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_sysanalyst: Kept a mainframe and a room of 486 PCs running, mostly at night.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_chemengineer: Process engineer at a chemical plant on the Ohio River.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_roboticsengineer: Programmed and repaired welding robots on an auto assembly line.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_bombtech: State police bomb squad. Slow hands, slower heartbeat.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_smokejumper: Parachuted into forest fires out West every summer.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_farrier: Shod horses on the Kentucky horse farms. Anvil in the truck bed.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_glassblower: Ran a small art-glass studio selling vases to tourists.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_roughneck: Two weeks on a Gulf of Mexico rig, two weeks home.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_taxidermist: Mounted deer heads and bass for every hunter in the county.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_lineman: Climbed poles in ice storms to keep the county lit.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_locksmith: Cut keys and rekeyed locks from a small shop downtown.
UI_profdesc_KRjobs_archaeologist: Dug up Native American sites along the Ohio Valley.
UI_trait_KRjobs_coldbloodedDesc: Calm under pressure, reloads without thinking.
